entities.summary: The Nicaraguan Socialist Party is a political party in Nicaragua. Mario Flores Ortiz. PSN operated as the official communist party in the country. At the time of its foundation, PSN supported the regime of Anastasio Somoza García. PSN considered that Somoza was an anti-fascist ally. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
